note: Provenance for every sample shipped in this app. Copied from the sibling project's pack; the files are byte-identical to it, so these records stay true. The MuldjordKit files are CC-BY 4.0 and the attribution they require is shown in the app; the claves file is CC0 and requires none. This exists so nobody has to rediscover what a file is or what was done to it.

samples.modifications: capped at 0.4 s, faded out over the last 80 ms, downmixed to mono, 44.1 kHz 16-bit FLAC (not trimmed: the source lead-in is kept; not normalised: the take-to-take level difference is the round-robin variation the renderer plays) then resampled down a perfect fifth (playback ratio 2^(-7/12) = 0.66742, so the strongest partial moves from 2337 Hz to 1556 Hz) and re-capped at 0.4 s with a fresh 80 ms fade-out — a bigger pair of sticks, and the take-to-take level difference is preserved: the two alternates were 2.53 dB apart before and are 2.50 dB apart after
